title: Shell scrolled the sidebar away and capped width at max-w-6xl
body: The spine rail scrolled off-screen on any long list and the page centred in a 6xl column. Rebuilt with the admin console's fixed-viewport mechanics: pinned rail with its own scroll, full-width main pane, mobile strip always visible. Verified at 390/768/1440px across all six pages — zero horizontal overflow.

title: Counter member search found nobody for a full name
body: "Kavya Rao" matched neither firstName nor lastName alone. memberSearch now also tries first-word(s)-as-firstName + rest-as-lastName and the reverse, for students and teachers. Spec added and proven by watching it fail without the fix.

title: Member card rendered "Class Class 6A"
body: className from the API is already the full display name; the card prepended another "Class". Grades without the word (UKG) masked the bug.

title: Staff attendance showed raw role enums (LIBRARIAN, HELPER, OFFICE)
body: Non-teaching rows rendered the enum verbatim beside teachers' title-cased label. All role renders now go through a label function.

status: open — needs the SMTP_PASS secret added to Vercel Preview env
title: Staging sends no email at all (SMTP_PASS missing)
body: Preview env has SMTP_HOST/USER/PORT/FROM but no SMTP_PASS, so every invite/notification on staging silently fails (emailSent:false) while production sends. Blocks QA of all notification flows on staging; login invites for staging test personas are stuck until fixed + resent.

title: A login's email can never be changed after creation
body: Login invites bind to the email at creation; there is no change-login-email endpoint and release() keeps userId so re-inviting is blocked. Any typo'd or dead address permanently strands the account (all 330 seeded logins point at unreachable @raffles.edu addresses). Suggest an admin 'change login email + re-invite' action with session revocation.

title: Invite emailSent:true only means the SMTP server accepted it
body: Bounces are invisible; admin UI shows 'invited' forever with no 'never set a password' view. Pairs with the proposed weekly pending-invites digest.

title: Letterhead — every email now wears the school's branding
body: All 12 message kinds render through one email-safe template carrying the school's crest, colour and footer, defaulting from the website profile so an unconfigured school is still branded. Admin Settings has an Email card (3 letterheads, sender name, reply-to, accent, footer, live preview, send-test). Schools may optionally send from their own mailbox (own domain or Gmail-style) with AES-256-GCM encrypted credentials; a sender is used only when VERIFIED by a real test send, and falls back to the platform mailbox on any failure. QA: check that every notification kind arrives branded, and that removing the custom sender returns mail to the Sckools sender without interruption.

title: Owner console can put a school on its own domain
body: Add a domain, get the exact DNS record (A for an apex, CNAME otherwise), attach it at the host, then Verify — which reads live DNS and refuses to mark it LIVE until it resolves here. Promote to primary (LIVE only) makes it the address used in invite links and email footers. QA: verify with a real domain end to end; check that a school stays reachable on its slug host throughout.

status: open — found while verifying a second school
title: Two school sessions in one browser collide (refresh cookie is scoped to .sckools.com)
body: The refresh cookie is deliberately set on the parent domain .sckools.com, so signing into two schools in the same browser leaves both refresh tokens under one cookie name. On reload the refresh returns whichever validates first, and the other school's pages then 401 with 'Token does not match this tenant' — the admin console renders but every query fails. Reproduced on production: an owner impersonation into Beacon worked immediately, then broke on the next reload because the existing Raffles session's cookie won. Mostly affects owners impersonating several schools and anyone administering two schools; a real parent with one school is unaffected. Options: name the cookie per school, or scope it to the school host instead of the parent domain.
